channel.title: Transport on Open Component Model
channel.description: Recent content in Transport on Open Component Model

item.title: Configure Registry Credentials
item.description:
Goal

Configure OCM to authenticate against multiple OCI registries — pinning explicit credentials for specific registries while using Docker config as a catch-all fallback.

item.title: Transfer Component Versions
item.description:
Goal

Move a component version from a source OCM repository to a target OCM repository with the default ocm transfer cv workflow. This is the base procedure that every other transfer guide builds on.

item.title: Transfer Components across an Air Gap
item.description:
Start from the base transfer guide

This guide builds on Transfer Component Versions. Read it first for the default ocm transfer cv workflow, credentials, and verification; the steps below only add the air-gap transport via a CTF archive.

item.title: Replicate Component Versions with the Controller
item.description:
Goal

Use the OCM Kubernetes controller to transfer a component version, together with the full graph of components it references (if recursion is enabled), from one OCM repository to another. The transfer re-runs automatically whenever the source Component resolves to a new version.

item.title: Download Resources
item.description:
Goal

Download resources from a component version using the OCM CLI. Learn how to fetch specific resources, optionally transform them to their native format, and save them to your local filesystem.

item.title: Download SBOMs
item.description:
Complete the pack guide first

This guide continues from Add SBOMs. It assumes the /tmp/ocm-sbom-tutorial workspace and the ./transport-archive CTF from that guide already exist, with a linked SBOM on the ocm-cli resource and the podinfo image carrying a BuildKit attestation. Complete it before running the steps below.

item.title: Pull OCI Artifacts Natively
item.description:
Complete the pack guide first

This guide continues from Add OCI Artifacts. It assumes you already built the component versions from that guide — an embedded OCI image layout, an externally referenced image, and an ORAS-fetched layout — each sitting in a local ./transport-archive CTF. Complete it before running the steps below.

item.title: Configure HTTP Behaviour
item.description: Control the HTTP behaviour OCM uses when talking to OCI registries and Helm repositories — globally and per-host — so that slow, flaky, or restricted networks do not cause silent hangs, premature failures, or surprise certificate errors.

item.title: Upload OCI Images
item.description:
Start from the base transfer guide

This guide builds on Transfer Component Versions. Read it first for the default ocm transfer cv workflow, credentials, and verification; the steps below only add the OCI uploader configuration.

item.title: Upload to a Custom Target
item.description:
Start from the base transfer guide

This guide builds on Transfer Component Versions. Read it first for the default ocm transfer cv workflow, credentials, and verification; the steps below only add routing resources to a custom upload target during transfer.

item.title: Upload to JFrog Artifactory
item.description:
Start from the base transfer guide

This guide specializes the default transfer workflow for JFrog Artifactory targets. If you have not transferred a component version before, read Transfer Component Versions first, then return here to route resources into Artifactory repositories.

item.title: Upload to Sonatype Nexus
item.description:
Start from the base transfer guide

This guide specializes the default transfer workflow for Sonatype Nexus targets. If you have not transferred a component version before, read Transfer Component Versions first, then return here to route resources into Nexus hosted repositories.
